content: docker compose 'restart' does NOT pick up docker-compose.yml changes (env vars, image tag, mounts are baked in at container creation) -- must use 'docker compose up -d' to recreate changed services. Don't mix Docker restart policies with external process managers -- creates conflicting recreate/restart races. A crash-looping container with restart:always will loop forever if the new image itself is broken -- rollback executor must detect this, not just fire-and-forget.
